decisions.statement: Every Deployment and Service and StatefulSet in the app namespaces is read.
Every manifest this repository's synth files name is read.
A live resource labelled as a deploy's that no manifest names has drifted from the code.
Each orphan found is sent to the handler as one message.
Every message this module sends is drift.
A resource nothing labels as a deploy's is passed over.
The manifests compared against are read from this checkout as that checkout now is.
The cluster is reached with the same credentials every other service here reaches the cluster with.
The whole cluster read is bounded by a ceiling the code settles.
A sweep that could not run ends the process rather than reading as clean.
Nothing waiting for the handler ends the run rather than losing the finding.

definition: live cluster resources no source manifest accounts for, found and put to the handler
